summary: No line-of-mars-palmistry article was drafted. Investigating the task's evidence boundary before drafting found that docs/editorial-backlog.md item 22's premise -- that the Line of Mars is a feature of its own, distinct from and 'frequently confused with' a double life line -- is contradicted by the repository's own already-published, already source-verified content, not merely under-evidenced. The live double-life-line-meaning.md article (pubDate 2026-05-27) already states 'This is the line William Benham called the Line of Mars, and what many modern practitioners refer to simply as a sister line or inner life line,' quoting Benham (1900) directly that the line and the life line 'are sister lines, in fact.' 04-life-line.mdx independently calls the same feature 'the sister line, also called the inner life line or Line of Mars.' docs/source-verification-log.md already records a corpus-verified Cheiro (1916) quotation attributed to his chapter 'The Line of Mars or Inner Life Line' -- Cheiro's own chapter title treats the two names as one subject. Drafting a standalone line-of-mars-palmistry article as authorized would require either inventing an unsupported distinction between 'Line of Mars' and the double life line/sister line (forbidden by the task's source-safety requirements) or substantially duplicating double-life-line-meaning.md's existing content under a new slug, which is a content-strategy/cannibalization decision (merge, redirect, retitle or retire backlog item 22, or a narrow SEO alias to the existing article) outside this task's bounded article-drafting scope and touching SEO/indexing strategy and other backlog priorities, both explicitly excluded. This worker's environment also blocks WebFetch for every external content domain tried (gutenberg.org, chestofbooks.com, superphysics.org, en.wikipedia.org, archive.org, www.google.com all EGRESS_BLOCKED; only github.com reachable), so the primary Cheiro text could not be re-read directly, though WebSearch corroboration and the repository's own prior corpus verification were sufficient to establish the identity conflict without it. Full evidence map recorded in docs/source-verification-log.md Pass 19. No article, palmistry meaning, route, or editorial-backlog.md content changed.
